description: This Java source file defines the class DeleteAclEntry, which represents a command to delete a single ACL entry associated with a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto platform. It contains methods for constructing the command, parsing from JSON, and accessing command properties, with details about the ACL subject and associated Thing ID.
